account_deletion.title: Delete account
account_deletion.body: Deleting your account erases your personal data and signs you out on every device. You can cancel within {days} days.
account_deletion.scheduled: Your account will be deleted on {date}.
account_deletion.cancelled: Your account will not be deleted.
account_deletion.step_up: Sign in again to confirm it is you.
account_deletion.held: We must keep some of your data for a legal reason; the rest is deleted as scheduled.
